title: Unfathomable Depths
description: A disturbed Argonian named From-Deepest-Fathoms wanders the Riften docks, haunted by memories from a Dwemer Lexicon. She begs the player to take the Lexicon and return it to Avanchnzel, a Dwemer ruin in the Jerall Mountains. Inside, ghostly echoes of a doomed expedition reveal the fate of four adventurers who sought the Lexicon's knowledge. Returning the Lexicon to its receptacle grants the passive effect Ancient Knowledge.

base_facts: I am an Argonian wandering the Riften docks, tormented by memories that are not my own.
I carry a Dwemer Lexicon that fills my mind with unbearable visions of the past.
I must find someone to take the Lexicon back to Avanchnzel and free me of this burden.

ENCOUNTER_FROM_DEEPEST_FATHOMS: I have told the stranger about the Lexicon and begged them to take it from me.
The memories from the Lexicon are driving me mad; I cannot keep it any longer.
ACCEPT_THE_LEXICON: I have handed the Lexicon to the stranger. They must return it to Avanchnzel in the west.
I feel relief now that the Lexicon is no longer in my possession.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The stranger has returned the Lexicon to Avanchnzel, fulfilling my desperate plea.
I am finally free of the unbearable visions and memories that tormented me on the Riften docks.
My mind is my own again, no longer haunted by the doomed expedition's fate.
I can finally find peace now that the Dwemer artifact is back where it belongs.

beats.comment: Player meets From-Deepest-Fathoms on the Riften docks and learns about the Lexicon and Avanchnzel. Quest is at stage 10.
Player accepts the Lexicon from From-Deepest-Fathoms. Quest advances to stage 100 and the objective is displayed.
Player has traveled through Avanchnzel and placed the Lexicon on its receptacle. The game sets stage 900.
Quest finishes at stage 1000. Player receives the Ancient Knowledge passive effect.
